# Platinum Fitness Club — Women Exclusive

> Women-only fitness club in Hyderabad, India, with branches in Malakpet, Attapur and Saidabad. Female trainers and clinically informed fitness for women of every age. We are fitness trainers, not doctors.

## Branches
- [Malakpet](malakpet.html) — 1st Floor, Zudio Building, opp. Metro Pillar 1456, Anand Nagar Colony, Malakpet, Hyderabad 500036. Phone +91 92810 22896. Google rating 4.7 from 307 reviews.
- [Attapur](attapur.html) — Plot 396, 1st Floor, Shree Bhagya Laxmi Plaza, opp. Pillar 151, Attapur, Hyderabad 500048. Phone +91 98493 40257. Google rating 4.9 from 666 reviews. EMS training is available at Attapur only.
- [Saidabad](saidabad.html) — Neo Platinum Fitness Club, 1st Floor, above Ratnadeep Supermarket, Zahoor Bagh, Shankeshwar Bazar, Saidabad, Hyderabad 500059. Phone +91 92810 22891. Google rating 5.0 from 40 reviews. Gym-only floor; no group classes are advertised.

## Membership and trials
- Free trial session with a body assessment, Monday to Saturday.
- Current offer: 3 months + 1 month free, subject to seats available.
- Plans of 1, 3, 6 and 12 months. No rupee prices are published on the website; request the current plan sheet on WhatsApp.
- Around 500 active members per branch, 1,500+ across the club, and 1,000+ Google reviews with a 4.8 average.

## Training
- Strength and conditioning, cardio, Pilates, yoga, Zumba, sauna and steam, personal training and nutrition guidance.
- Programmes are adapted for PCOS, thyroid, diabetes, menopause, post-partum recovery and joint-friendly training, based on guidance from the member's own doctor or physiotherapist.
- Members range from women in their twenties to women in their sixties.
